findings.evidence: Line-weighted H2 classification: Load (5 lines) is expert routing; Choose the evidence scope (15) mixes expert corrections and activation; Git gotchas (6) mixes expert corrections and activation; Select and verify (8) is mostly expert procedure; Present (12) and NEVER (5) are predominantly activation.
